known.via: English Wikipedia "Tejo DOC" (redirects to "Tejo wine region")

blurb.text: A regional wine area along the Tagus river, which moderates its climate. Fernão Pires is the most planted grape at 37 percent. Until 2009 the regional wine was labeled Ribatejano.
